basic_info.description: Loaded with charm, this beautiful home is great for entertaining and has an excellent floor plan featuring two spacious bedrooms and one remodeled bathroom on the main level, a large living room with fireplace, formal dining area, large open remodeled kitchen, and lovely deck overlooking the wonderful yard. The lower level has an additional garden bedroom and updated bathroom. The garage includes storage space, laundry area and one car garage. The beautiful backyard is great for relaxation or gatherings complete with bocce ball area. Great location across from Golden Gate Park near golf, archery, soccer, trails, lakes, Queen Wilhelmina Garden, the amazing Ocean Beach, shops and eateries.
